title: Connecticut completion with only one rent cushion
description: Connecticut completion with only one rent cushion. Connecticut completes the set and leaves enough cash for ordinary taxes, so the auction risk dominates. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: I own the other two Light Blue properties (Oriental and Vermont). Buying Connecticut for $120 completes the set, allowing me to build houses soon and increase rent dramatically. I have $310 cash, leaving $190 after purchase, which is sufficient for future expenses. Letting an auction happen could let another player acquire the monopoly, which would be disastrous. So I will buy.

Leaves at least $120 after the action.
